req.title: Task creation persists
req.statement: The system shall commit new task rows so subsequent GET calls return them across requests.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-021 requires that POST /tasks/ commits new task rows so subsequent GET calls return them. Tests must cover: (1) positive EP — a valid task is created and retrievable via GET /tasks/{id}; (2) negative NEG — invalid payloads (null title, over-length title, over-length description, null completed) are rejected with 422; (3) boundary BVA — title at exactly 1 char (min) and 100 chars (max) are accepted, title at 0 chars and 101 chars are rejected; (4) STC — state transition from non-existent to persisted, confirmed by GET; (5) DT — completed=true vs completed=false both persist correctly. All tests use in-process TestClient with a fresh in-memory SQLite DB to ensure isolation and determinism.

preconditions: App is running in-process with a clean in-memory SQLite DB
No tasks exist with the title 'Read chapter 5 test'
actions: POST /tasks/ with valid title, description, completed=false
Assert 201 response with correct payload fields

tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.main import app
from app.database import get_db
from app import models

engine = create_engine("sqlite:///:memory:", connect_args={"check_same_thread": False})
TestingSessionLocal = sessionmaker(autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=engine)
models.Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)

def override_get_db():
    db = TestingSessionLocal()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()

app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db
client = TestClient(app)

def test_create_task_positive_persists_via_get():
    payload = {"title": "Read chapter 5 test", "description": "Some description", "completed": False}
    r_post = client.post("/tasks/", json=payload)
    assert r_post.status_code == 201
    data = r_post.json()
    assert data["title"] == "Read chapter 5 test"
    assert data["description"] == "Some description"
    assert data["completed"] == False
    assert "id" in data
    assert "created_at" in data
    task_id = data["id"]
    r_get = client.get(f"/tasks/{task_id}")
    assert r_get.status_code == 200
    get_data = r_get.json()
    assert get_data["id"] == task_id
    assert get_data["title"] == "Read chapter 5 test"
    assert get_data["description"] == "Some description"
    assert get_data["completed"] == False

test_create_task_positive_persists_via_get()

from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.main import app
from app.database import get_db
from app import models

engine5 = create_engine("sqlite:///:memory:", connect_args={"check_same_thread": False})
TestingSessionLocal5 = sessionmaker(autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=engine5)
models.Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine5)

def override_get_db5():
    db = TestingSessionLocal5()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()

app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db5
client5 = TestClient(app)

def test_state_transition_not_found_to_persisted():
    r_pre = client5.get("/tasks/999")
    assert r_pre.status_code == 404
    payload = {"title": "Organize desk", "description": None, "completed": False}
    r_post = client5.post("/tasks/", json=payload)
    assert r_post.status_code == 201
    d = r_post.json()
    new_id = d["id"]
    assert d["title"] == "Organize desk"
    assert d["completed"] == False
    r_get = client5.get(f"/tasks/{new_id}")
    assert r_get.status_code == 200
    gd = r_get.json()
    assert gd["id"] == new_id
    assert gd["title"] == "Organize desk"
    assert gd["completed"] == False

test_state_transition_not_found_to_persisted()
